# The Ministry of Finance (Department of Economic Affairs) No. F. 4(l)-W&M/60, dated the 1st March, 1960, it is hereby, notified for general information that the Five-Year Interest-free Prize Bonds, 1965, shown in the Schedule appended hereto have won the prizes indicated against them at the Seventh quarterly draw for prizes held on 1st March, 1962.

MINISTRY OF FINANCE (Department of Economic Affairs) NOTIFICATION New Delhi, the nth March 1962 No. F. 25(21)-NS/62.—In pursuance of paragraph 7 of the Notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Finance (Department of Economic Affairs) No. F. 4(l)-W&M/60, dated the 1st March, 1960, It is hereby, notified for general information that the Five-Year Interest-free Prize Bonds, 1965, shown in the Schedule appended hereto have won the prizes indicated against them at the Seventh quarterly draw for prizes held on 1st March, 1962.

SHIV NAUBH SINGH, Joint Secy.

( 93 )
